name: hl_compile
description: Builds HashLink/C programs into native executables or WebAssembly straight from the Haxe compiler.
releasenote: Added the haxelib run commands (doctor, build, run, watch, clean, package, vscode, new-module), extra flags (hl_cflags, hl_ldflags, hl_lto, hl_asan), shared compile cache, parallel hdll builds, hl_module.xml <requires>, build-time warnings for missing hdlls, c code injection and moree.
